name: RMAC Cross Country Championships
headline: RMAC: Mines, Adams State and Western Colorado in one race
summary: The best conference meet in D-II. The men’s race has No. 2 Colorado School of Mines, No. 3 Adams State and No. 9 Western Colorado. The women’s race has four top-10 teams: No. 1 Adams State, No. 3 Mines, No. 5 Western Colorado and No. 7 UC-Colorado Springs.
